heroTitle: Taking a product from mockup to database.
heroText: 3 years building interfaces and the backends behind them. React and Next.js up front, Prisma and PostgreSQL underneath. Sites for Dubai, Chechnya, and Telegram — in two languages.
aboutText: My diploma is in frontend development, but in practice I own the whole cycle: from React layouts to APIs, Prisma, and PostgreSQL. Over 3 years I built a site for a Dubai service business, a business-card site for a Chechen entrepreneur, and a Telegram Mini App with an admin panel — all three hand-coded, no builders or templates.
aboutText2: Alongside development, I run P2P crypto exchanges — acting as a middleman between USDT buyers and sellers. It's not code, but it's exactly why I understand crypto-business products from the inside, not just from a spec.

beyondText: Beyond development, I run practical P2P crypto operations — buying and selling USDT as a middleman between both sides of a deal. That experience fed directly into building products for crypto businesses, from exchange landing pages to Telegram request forms.
